individual-data-points.explanation: Top bar chart shows mean cell-death percentages with error bars but no individual experimental data points are overlaid.
Bar chart of cell death percentages shows only bars with error bars, no individual data points.
Grouped bar chart of mean cell death across time points shows error bars but no individual replicate points.
Bar chart of cell death percentages shows means with error bars but no individual data points are displayed.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars in the bar chart are defined in the caption as mean +/- SD of three independent experiments.
Bar chart displays error bars but the caption text for panel B gives no statistical definition for them.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Mean+/-s.d. of three experiments is reported.

Bar chart shows error bars (e.g., on the first MEF group) but the caption does not state what they represent.
